# LeanyLabs

> > Software development company specializing in monday.com apps, custom web solutions, and team extension services using Node.js, React, TypeScript, and AWS.

LeanyLabs is a Ukrainian software outsourcing partner with expertise in building monday.com marketplace apps, MVP development, and full-stack JavaScript solutions. The company has received recognition from GoodFirms and serves clients with microservices architecture, workflow automation, and modern web technologies.

## Key Topics

- monday.com apps development
- Node.js & TypeScript
- React & frontend development
- Custom software solutions
- MVP development
- Microservices architecture
- AWS cloud infrastructure
- Workflow automation
- Team extension & outsourcing
- MongoDB & databases
- JavaScript development
- Software development services
- Product development
- Docker & DevOps
- OpenTelemetry & monitoring
